employees.basis: approximately 57,000 full-time, part-time and temporary workers, the overwhelming majority of which were full-time employees

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: At September 27, 2026, we had approximately 57,000 full-time, part-time and temporary workers, the overwhelming majority of which were full-time employees.

payroll.label: annual total compensation of our median employee

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: For fiscal 2025, our last completed fiscal year: • the annual total compensation of our CEO, as shown in the Summary Compensation Table, was $29,701,097; • the annual total compensation of our median employee, calculated as described below, was $101,639; and • the resulting ratio was 292 : 1.

notes: Employees: Qualcomm reports an approximate count of all full-time, part-time and temporary workers at its fiscal year end. Payroll: the FY2026 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the CEO pay ratio median from the January 2026 proxy is used; it is the fiscal 2025 median (employee population of approximately 52,000 at September 28, 2025), a year behind the head count. The fiscal 2026 median will appear only in the proxy due in January 2027.
